$comment: c88 (D-RUNTIME-MAIN-ARGC-ARGV): the program-entry argc/argv RUN witness. The shipped elf64-*-linux-exec formats declare `processArgs` = stack-vector (SysV AMD64 psABI 3.4.1 / AAPCS64 Linux: argc at [sp+0], the in-place NULL-terminated argv vector at sp+8), so the entry trampoline loads argc into argGprs[0] and LEAs the vector's address into argGprs[1] BEFORE calling main. The runner spawns with no extra args -> main must see argc==1 + a non-empty argv[0] (the program path) + argv[1]==NULL -> exit 42; each failed layer exits a distinct 90..94 (see main.c). The pe64 leg RUNS, and as of UCRT-P4 (D-FFI-PE-CRT-UCRT-MIGRATION) through a DIFFERENT mechanism than c111's: the Windows OS entry receives NO C argument vector, so a MIR-tier synthesized pre-main init (realizeEntryShape in src/mir/merge/synth_pe_startup.cpp) calls the UCRT populate export _configure_narrow_argv(1) and then dereferences the accessors __p___argc / __p___argv exactly ONCE each, and forwards (argc, argv) to main. c111 used the msvcrt out-parameter exports __getmainargs / __wgetmainargs; those are msvcrt-ONLY (MEASURED 2026-08-10, objdump -p: msvcrt ord 138 / 167, ucrtbase exports NEITHER), so the CRT migration had to change the MECHANISM rather than repoint it. Wide-vs-narrow is still chosen by the RESOLVED ENTRY'S SIGNATURE -- now via the matched LANGUAGE entry row's materialization verb -- never a format flag -> the SAME main.c must see argc==1 + a non-empty argv[0] (the program path) + argv[1]==NULL -> exit 42 on Windows too, exercising the CRT out-parameter arm end-to-end. RED-on-disable: remove `processArgs` from the pe64 (or either ELF) shipped exec JSON (runtime-read config) -> that leg reads garbage entry-register argc -> exit 90 instead of 42. NOTE WHAT THIS EXAMPLE CANNOT WITNESS, so a green run is not read as more coverage than it is: the examples runner spawns with NO extra arguments, so argc==1 is the only case reachable here. Real arguments -- three of them, one containing a SPACE and one shaped like a GLOB, with every argv element compared BYTE-EXACT -- are witnessed by tests/program/test_entry_argv_run.cpp, which owns its own spawn.
